isLoading.description: Whether the list is loading (includes both fetching and sorting).

isLoadingMore.description: Whether the list is loading more items via pagination.

isSorting.description: Whether a client-side sort is in progress.

hasMore.description: Whether there are more items to load.

error.description: The error instance returned by the last fetch.

abort.description: Function to abort the current fetch.

setSorting.description:
Function to update the sorting state and trigger a sort.
Accepts a value or an updater function.

setFilter.description:
Function to update the filter state and trigger a reload.
Accepts a value or an updater function.

clearFilter.description:
Function to reset the filter to `initialFilter`.
No-op if `initialFilter` was not provided.

load.type: (args: LoadDetails<Item, Filter, Sorting, Cursor>) => Promise<LoadResult<Item, Cursor>>
load.description: The function to call when the list is loaded

sort.type:
| ((args: SortDetails<Item, Filter, Sorting>) => Promise<{ items: Item[] }> | { items: Item[] } | undefined)
    | undefined
sort.description:
The function to call when the list is sorted client-side.
When provided, sorting is performed locally instead of triggering a new load.

keepPreviousItems.description:
Whether to keep the previous items visible while new data is loading.
Prevents content flash when filter or sort changes.

dependencies.description: The dependencies to watch for changes

autoReload.description: Whether to automatically reload the list when the dependencies change

onSuccess.description: The function to call when the list is loaded successfully

onError.description: The function to call when the list fails to load
